name: list_acls
description: List all ACLs for Google Cloud Managed Service for Apache Kafka for a given project, location, and cluster.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of ACLs to return.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListAcls` call.

parent.description: Required. The parent cluster whose ACLs are to be listed. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster_id}
